title: Clicks and the mandatory draw
intro:
You are the Corp. Each turn you get 3 clicks — the actions you take — and you start every turn by drawing a card whether you like it or not (the mandatory draw). Your hand is HQ; your deck is R&D; your discard pile is Archives. The Runner cannot see what is in your hand, but they can run at any of those three servers to look.

This lesson: keep your opening hand, spend three clicks, and end your turn.
outro: That is a whole Corp turn: draw, three clicks, end. Clicking for a credit and clicking to draw are the two basic actions you can always take. Next: playing an operation to make money faster than one credit a click.

steps.prose: Both players start with 5 cards and 5 credits. You may mulligan — shuffle your hand back and draw 5 new cards — but this hand is fine. Keep it.
Your turn began with the mandatory draw, so HQ now holds 6 cards. You have 3 clicks. The simplest action: click for 1 credit.
You can also spend a click to draw a card from R&D. Do that now.
One click left. Take another credit, then end your turn. Your maximum hand size is 5, so with 7 cards in HQ you will discard 2 to Archives first — discard Tithe and Urtica Cipher.
steps.hint: Gain 1 credit, End turn, then discard down to 5.
